original_test_intent: Immediately power off the intended running SUT through the documented BMC Web UI control and prove the approved off/standby state without wrong-target action or unexplained platform events.
original_method: Verify target/on state and absence of active writes or updates, preserve baseline, issue exactly one approved immediate-off request, monitor OS/chassis/storage/event transitions and leave recovery under owner control.
manual_activity: The owner confirms immediate rather than orderly shutdown, accepts service/data-loss risk and validates storage/update safety; an operator supervises the transition and any recovery.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC identity and verified on state
Active workload, storage-write and firmware-update safety assessment
Documented Web UI immediate-off action or approved equivalent
Protected credentials, final off/standby signal and timeout
safety_requirements: Reject active writes or firmware updates
Require exact target and immediate-off semantics
Protect credentials and management endpoint identity
Do not substitute sensor reads, orderly shutdown, reset or AC cycle
Stop on ambiguous or partial transition
Do not retry or power on automatically
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, on state, approval and safety gates
Monitor chassis, console, storage and BMC state
Preserve post-action evidence without retry, recovery autonomy or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve destructive immediate off and risk

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: TEMP_PSU sensor listing belongs to row 788 and neither performs nor verifies immediate off.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented protected Web UI/API immediate-off action once after all destructive safety gates pass.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Immediate BMC Web UI power-off, no-error criteria, scripts and 1/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit data-loss gate, secure control, authoritative final state and no-retry recovery boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: PSU sensor visibility cannot prove any power transition or its system impact.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Immediate loss can corrupt storage, interrupt firmware and leave the host unavailable.

project_override_considerations: Any API alternative must be documented as semantically equivalent to Web UI immediate off. Orderly shutdown, reset and AC removal are separate actions and cannot silently replace it.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/on state and active-write/update safety assessment
Approved final off/standby state and BMC behavior
Post-action event comparison, recovery actions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1510 consistently defines immediate BMC power-off. The reused-code row 788 is isolated as a separate PSU thermal variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target, approval, safety state, supported control and final-state rules are finite project inputs, allowing conditional attended execution.

review_improvement: Rejects the copied PSU sensor procedure and defines the destructive one-request immediate-off workflow, data-safety gate and evidence boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: Immediate off is fundamentally different from graceful shutdown: completion can be automated, but the irreversible risk decision and recovery remain human-owned. A sensor command provides no evidence for the requested mutation.
